table: Table S1: settings of the two residual CNNs of Fig. S1

bottleneck.output_per_site: C = 2 D^4 = 512 real elements of the parity-conserving site tensor T(n), D = 4

normal.output_per_site: backflow features y_up(n), y_dn(n) of dimension d: d = 32 for the Pfaffian backflow (the two halves of the C channels), d = 64 for the BCS backflow (learned linear layer on all C channels)
normal.parameters: 1.2 M; total of the backflow ansatz, depends on the ansatz and on L (see parameter_counts)

shared.embedding: learned C-dimensional vector per site occupation (empty, up, down, double), shared by all sites
shared.convolutions: 3x3 with circular padding for periodic boundaries, 1x1 in the bottleneck
shared.normalization: RMSNorm over all channels and sites, without learnable affine parameters
shared.output_scaling: output of the last block divided by sqrt(16 + 1)
shared.arithmetic: real-valued, float32 with TF32 in convolutions and matrix multiplications
